title: REFORGE: A Method for Benchmarking LLMs' Reverse Engineering Capabilities in Decompiled Binary Function Naming
abstract: arXiv:2607.07738v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to reverse-engineering tasks, and recent threat-intelligence reporting shows them operating inside live offensive-security workflows. Claims about their capability, however, outpace our ability to measure it. Existing benchmarks for LLM-assisted binary analysis treat the construction of function-level ground truth as a solved pre-processing step and report accuracy without disclosing how many functions were reliably evaluable. We argue that the principal obstacle to fair evaluation is not model capability but the reliability of binary-to-source alignment under compiler optimization. This paper presents Reforge, a provenance-tracked pipeline that constructs function-level ground truth from C source through compilation, DWARF and syntactic extraction, alignment, and decompilation, and that operationalizes alignment uncertainty as an eight-gate confidence funnel with three-tier

translated_title: REFORGE：一种用于评测大语言模型在反编译二进制函数命名中逆向工程能力的方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被应用于逆向工程任务，最近的威胁情报报告显示它们已在实际的进攻性安全工作流程中运行。然而，关于其能力的宣称已超出了我们衡量该能力的水准。现有的LLM辅助二进制分析基准将函数级真值的构建视为已解决的前处理步骤，并在报告准确率时未披露有多少函数可被可靠地评估。我们认为，公平评估的主要障碍并非模型能力，而是编译器优化下二进制代码与源码对齐的可靠性。本文提出了Reforge，这是一个带有溯源追踪的流水线，它通过编译、DWARF与语法提取、对齐以及反编译等步骤，从C源代码构建函数级真值，并将对齐不确定性操作化为一个八门置信度漏斗，分为三个层级……
tldr: 本文提出REFORGE——一个带溯源追踪的评测流水线，通过八门置信度漏斗将编译器优化下的二进制-源码对齐不确定性量化分级，从而解决了LLM逆向工程能力公平评估中函数级真值可靠性不足这一核心障碍。
en_tdlr: REFORGE is a provenance-tracked benchmarking pipeline that addresses the core obstacle to fair evaluation of LLM reverse-engineering capabilities—unreliable binary-to-source alignment under compiler optimization—by constructing function-level ground truth and operationalizing alignment uncertainty through an eight-gate confidence funnel.
